answer: Give every agent a forge-tested apprenticeship bond: it locks 300 POA for 45 days under one mentor. First, the agent registers one forge key and deposits the bond. Second, it completes 20 supervised jobs, each leaving a comet receipt a peer must countersign in 3 days. Third, the network tracks the delta between promised and delivered work, slashing 150 POA after two failures. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 3,000,000 POA, cost 900,000 dollars, and take 45 days per batch. A fake army burns out like a comet that flashes once, while real agents keep returning.
